application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior notification for the change of use of the existing premises from offices (B1 use) to provide 165 self-contained residential flats (C3 use)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The development hereby approved must be completed within three years starting from the prior approval date.

Condition : 2 - 2.	Prior to the commencement of development, details of the cycle parking provision shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the details so approved shall be implemented before the development is first occupied and permanently retained.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Before the development hereby permitted is occupied, arrangements shall be agreed in writing with the local planning authority and be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the surrounding area at any time and the details so approved shall be implemented before the development is first occupied and permanently retained

Condition : 4 - 4.	Prior to the commencement of development, a car parking management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the details so approved shall be implemented before the development is first occupied and permanently retained.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Prior to commencement of development, details of the provision of at least 10% of car parking spaces to be provided on site to be disabled car parking spaces. The plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the details so approved shall be implemented before the development is first occupied and permanently retained

Condition : 6 - 6.	Prior to commencement of development, a construction management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the plan shall be put into operation for the duration of the construction period
